p2pPendingBrowserEvidence.contractNote: Pending means client request-in-flight only. OpenAPI declares the eventual create receipt (201 created), mark-paid (200 paid) and release (200 released); it does not define a pending server result for these transitions.

predictionsPendingBrowserEvidence.notes: The 2-second request-in-flight delay and final filled receipt are local preview fixtures; not backend processing or settlement.

profileSuccessBrowserEvidence.notes: All profile API responses came from local service worker. Developer mock carries required Profile scopes, but MSW does not enforce them; no backend authorization, persistence or user acceptance is verified.

profileEmptyBrowserEvidence.notes: Three linked Profile collections returned empty 200 fixtures; the supporting getProfile remained the normal fixture. All responses came from local service worker; no backend authorization or user acceptance is verified.

profileErrorBrowserEvidence.notes: Each of four GETs received 6 synthetic 503 responses initially and 6 after one Retry; mean response time was 3 ms in the local service worker. Profile OpenAPI declares only 200/401 for these operations, so 503 is not contract evidence. MSW does not enforce profile:read; no backend authorization, persistence, staging, or user acceptance is verified.

profileUnauthorizedBrowserEvidence.notes: Auth OpenAPI declares refreshSession 200/AuthSession-or-null only; each 401-triggered refresh is a runner-local 200/null contract fixture, not a network or backend response.
